primary_endpoint: Mean stochastic capped episode length at the final planned update
primary_contrast: baseline minus plain, paired by independent training seed
primary_test: Two-sided within-pair label-swap permutation test of mean difference
design_rationale: Eight earlier pilot pairs at update 60 had difference SD 27.28 steps. A rough normal calculation suggests about 10 pairs for 80% power at a 25-step effect; use 30 because that pilot and approximation are uncertain. This is planning, not a power guarantee.
stop_rule: Collect every planned run; do not inspect p-values to decide when to stop.
failure_rule: Policy failures count as short episodes; simulator errors abort and are not dropped.
sampling: Initialization/training randomness is paired within each seed; different pairs have disjoint monitoring and endpoint evaluation seed sets.
